title: One registration per place of business, with terms that differ by registrant type
rule_summary: A SEPARATE controlled substance registration is required at EACH PRINCIPAL PLACE OF BUSINESS where the licensee or registrant manufactures, distributes or dispenses controlled substances. The term differs by registrant: a registration issued to a PHARMACY is valid for two years beginning January 1st of each EVEN-NUMBERED year; a registration issued to an OUTSOURCING FACILITY is valid for two years beginning January 1st of each even-numbered year; and a registration issued to a WHOLESALE DRUGGIST is valid for ONE year beginning DECEMBER 1st of each year.
exam_relevance: Tests that the registration term is not uniform, and that the wholesale term differs from the others in both length and start date.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.conditions: beginning January 1st of each even-numbered year

numeric_facts.fact: Wholesale druggist controlled substance registration term

common_confusions: Assuming a single biennial cycle governs every registrant
Assuming one registration covers several locations under one owner
Assuming the wholesale cycle also starts on January 1st
